recognition: Cartographic classification in Natural Earth: Sovereign country. This classification is not a statement of international recognition.
provenance: Country facts are from the archived CIA World Factbook mirror. Officeholders and economic/military data are reference observations, not a live update.
summary: Republic of Iceland. Unitary parliamentary republic.
rulers: President Halla TOMASDOTTIR (since 1 August 2024); Prime Minister Kristrun FROSTADOTTIR (since 21 December 2024)
economy: high-income North Atlantic island economy; not an EU member but market integration via European Economic Area (EEA); dominant tourism, fishing, and aluminum industries vulnerable to demand swings and disruption from volcanic activity; inflation remains above target rate; barriers to foreign business access and economic diversification GDP (PPP): $26.561 billion (2024 est.). note: data in 2021 dollars
military: no regular military forces; the Icelandic National Police, the regional police forces, and the Icelandic Coast Guard fall under the purview of the Ministry of Justice (2025)
origin: 1 December 1918 (became a sovereign state under the Danish Crown); 17 June 1944 (from Denmark; birthday of Jon SIGURDSSON, leader of Iceland's 19th-century independence movement)
asOf: Archived Factbook edition; individual figures retain their stated years.
